0022600151.text: The Bucks (1-4, 14th in the East) host the Cavaliers (3-1, 5th in the East) in Milwaukee's sixth game of the season, with Milwaukee coming off a loss and sitting 1-2 at home, while Cleveland has won three straight and is 3-0 at home. Cleveland's Meleek Thomas is out with a foot injury, and Milwaukee has no players listed as unavailable. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Milwaukee lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 123-116 defeat in Milwaukee on March 17, 2026.
